thread:
elaine (docs): Hi all — noticed the /v1/rerank API example in the API ref shows "queries" as a single object instead of an array. This will confuse users doing batch reranks. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/3124

matt (eng): Oof, yeah that snippet slipped in during the last rewrite. The runtime expects queries: [ { query: "..." } ] for batching. We should update both the curl example and the JS/TS SDK snippet.

nina (sdk): I can update the SDK examples once doc snippet is fixed. Note: our TS client currently types `queries` as string | string[] because of legacy. We should change to Array<{ query: string, top_k?: number }> and add a migration note.

jordan (api): Confirming: API accepted payloads where queries is an array of objects for at least 6 months. Backwards compat: single-string queries were supported by auto-wrapping, but we removed that last quarter — so docs must not show single-string usage.

elaine (docs): Good catch on the auto-wrap removal. I'll avoid showing the single-string form. Can someone paste the corrected curl + JSON body so I can push a small PR patch?

matt (eng): Fixed example below — feel free to copy. Also added a short comment in the body about per-query top_k.

```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{
    "model": "rerank-large-v1",
    "queries": [
      {"query": "Which doc explains tokenization?", "top_k": 5},
      {"query": "How to set up a dedicated pool?", "top_k": 3}
    ],
    "documents": [
      "Doc A text...",
      "Doc B text...",
      "Doc C text..."
    ]
  }'
```

matt (eng): Example response shape (abridged):

```json
{
  "results": [
    {
      "query_index": 0,
      "scores": [0.97, 0.65, 0.44],
      "document_indices": [0,2,1]
    },
    {
      "query_index": 1,
      "scores": [0.88, 0.40, 0.12],
      "document_indices": [2,0,1]
    }
  ]
}
```

nina (sdk): Thanks — I'll update the JS/TS snippet to use `queries: [{ query, top_k }]` and bump the SDK minor version. I'll open a PR that references docs PR 3124 and link the SDK change.

jordan (api): Can we add a short migration note in the API ref: "Previously allowed single-string queries are deprecated; please send an array of query objects". Also add a note about ordering: results array matches queries order by query_index.

elaine (docs): Perfect. I'll edit PR 3124 with the curl + response example + migration note. Will also add a short inline callout for `top_k` per query.

ci-bot: docs build for PR 3124 passed (green) — link: https://ci.redwood.ai/3124/builds/89 ✅

nina (sdk): PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk-js/pull/789 — updates types and snippets. I referenced docs PR in the description.

matt (eng): LGTM on the examples. One tiny nit: change `documents` example to show an object list variant when rerank request is doing per-doc metadata, e.g. `documents: [{ id: "d1", text: "..." }]`. Not required but useful.

elaine (docs): Added both array-of-strings and array-of-objects examples to the docs PR, with note about optional per-doc id metadata. Pushed patch.

jordan (api): Thanks everyone — after SDK PR merges, I'll schedule a quick internal note for partners so they don't rely on old single-string behavior. :thumbsup:

elaine (docs): Closing the loop: docs PR updated, SDK PR linked, migration note added. I'll merge after a final proofread. Thanks! :rocket:
